lines.text: The LORD, who formed Jacob from the womb, says not to be afraid and promises to pour out His Spirit.
One person will write "The LORD's" on his forehead and will take the name of Israel.
The LORD says He is the first and the last, and that His people are His witnesses.
The blacksmith forges an idol with hammers, and the woodworker shapes his idol with chisels and a compass in the likeness of a bull.
The LORD has blotted out Israel's sins like a mist and calls the heavens and the mountains to sing.
